name: EPIC 201849558
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 10.1 solar radii and 1.27 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,438 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 1.27 solar masses and 10.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,204 K at its surface.
